problems: Cliopatria's 'Mahajanapadas' row (slug mahajanapadas, -480..-451, 5,163.5 km2) repeats the Vajji shape after the Vajji row ends in -481; the mahajanapadas dossier (other part) should treat it as Vajji, not as a state. janapada-of-vajji runs to -468 with a new keyframe janapada-of-vajji_-480.

janapada-of-matsya, -pancala and -surasena are extended beyond Cliopatria's -405 (ends -350, -340, -334) because Cliopatria's Shaishunaga shape holds none of their land and its Nanda shape from -333 holds all of it; the nanda-empire dossier should carry the matching gains, and there are stateless gaps of 16 (Matsya) and 6 (Pancala) years unless it starts earlier.

magadha-haryanka-dynasty ends -413 (page) against Cliopatria's -405; the magadha-shaishunaga-dynasty dossier should start in 413 or -412..-405 is a gap. Its start (-500) follows Cliopatria; the page says 544 BCE.
magadha-haryanka-dynasty cuts Vatsa out of Cliopatria's -450 shape (the Vatsa page gives Vatsa to Avanti first) and keeps Cedi at confidence 1; janapada-of-cedi has no successor.
Eight distinct pages were opened (nine WebFetch calls; the Ajatashatru page twice). The Haryanka dossier used four pages against a 1-2 budget; the janapadas used one each (Vajji two).

All keyframe corrections for the five janapadas are my readings of the pages' place names (radii or one polygon); no page gives an area, so no infobox comparison was possible. Capital coordinates for places not in the gazetteer are approximate and mine.
No earlier report for sa-01-c existed; no dossier of mine existed before this run; nothing was kept from an earlier run. Temporary files were only under /tmp/claude-0/work/research-sa-01-c/.
